question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Quietness
solution:
The correct answer is '**Agitation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Quietness**: The term '**quietness**' refers to the state of being silent, calm, or tranquil. It denotes a lack of noise, motion, or disruption. (शांति or नीरवता)

 
 
• **Example**: "The **quietness **of the early morning was a relief from the bustle of the day."
 
 
 
• **Agitation**: The term '**agitation**' implies a state of anxiety or nervous excitement, or the action of briskly stirring or disturbing something. (उत्तेजना or आंदोलन)
 
 
• **Example**: "The **agitation **in the crowd was obvious in the face of the controversial decision."
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for 'quietness' is 'agitation'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speed**: This refers to the rate at which someone or something moves or operates. (गति or रफ्तार)
 
• **Kindness**: 'Kindness' signifies the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate. (दया or कृपा)
 
• **Slowness**: This state or condition pertains to lack of speed or the ability of someone or something to function slowly. (मन्दी or धीमापन)
